name: Jeff Shiver
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Atlanta, Georgia
education: University of Georgia School of Law
about: A partner at Shiver Hamilton Campbell, LLC, located in Atlanta, Georgia, Jeff Shiver represents individuals and families in complex personal injury litigation. His practice encompasses a broad range of matters, including personal injury, medical malpractice and products liability claims. Dedicated to advocating for those harmed by negligence, he works to help clients pursue meaningful compensation and accountability through strategic negotiation and trial advocacy.

Mr. Shiver has built a reputation as a skilled litigator with substantial courtroom experience. In 2023, he served as lead trial attorney in what became the largest wrongful death verdict in Georgia history, securing a $140 million verdict in DeKalb County State Court. His ability to handle high-stakes litigation reflects both his meticulous preparation and commitment to achieving favorable outcomes for injured clients and their families.

Known for his client-centered approach, Mr. Shiver understands the physical, emotional and financial challenges individuals face following serious injuries. He prioritizes clear communication and works closely with clients throughout every stage of the legal process, ensuring they remain informed and confident as their cases progress.

Mr. Shiver earned a Bachelor of Business Administration in insurance from the University of Georgia in 1999. He went on to receive his Juris Doctor, cum laude, from the University of Georgia School of Law in Athens, Georgia, in 2004.

Admitted to practice in Georgia, Mr. Shiver is also admitted before the U.S. District Courts for the Northern and Middle Districts of Georgia, the Georgia Court of Appeals, the Supreme Court of Georgia and the United States Court of Appeals for the 11th Circuit.

Active in the legal community, Mr. Shiver maintains memberships in numerous professional organizations, including the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association, the State Bar of Georgia, the American Bar Association, the Atlanta Bar Association and the Joseph Henry Lumpkin American Inn of Court, where he serves as a barrister.
